inventory_semantics.fully_authority_closed: Requires target/kind, exact discriminator grammar, containing-record identity, and normative schema_field_order. None currently qualifies.

inventory_semantics.target_kind_closed: Only allowed_target_tables and reference kind are bounded by current evidence; other row fields remain pending.

cross_record_invariants.invariant: Kind-selected source provenance fields and allocation selectors obey the exact LIVE_LOCATED/projection/fresh matrix.
Canonical and projection source labels, id sites, operations and consumer sites jointly delimit process-local identity use.
Exactly the outer runtime-value kind selects one RuntimeKindPayload branch; unselected payload fields are absent.
Exactly one nested value contract or complete child-identity/type pair is present.
SCC members and edge endpoints are VALIDATES views and create no runtime graph edge.
Authorization graph nodes, edges and topological order are derived exactly from AUTH_REQUIRES classifications; target precedes source.
Runtime graph nodes and edges are derived only from runtime-state reference bindings; SCC labels are validating views.
source_label is VALIDATES, target_label alone is RUNTIME_REF, and reference_ordinal equals that target leaf global ordinal.
transfer_label is the unique VALIDATES inverse of the AUTH_REQUIRES transfer.callback_binding_label; callback load selectors obey source_kind.
Located handle, receiver value, owner type, raw member, contracts and model close one exact bound member.
Stored expressions have 1..32 clauses, bounded acyclic tree expansion, canonical normalization, and four recursive re-entry sites.
Exactly one of atomic_value_contract_label and structured_state_contract_label is non-null; position/keyword follows argument kind.
Nested paths are non-empty, unique, start at a declared field, and select discriminator-specific content digests.
Exactly one positional index or keyword is present for an argument contract.
Producing semantic model is independently frozen and the value contract is exact.
Cardinality, reiterability, single-pass and view-kind fields are jointly constrained by iterable kind.
Cause/context references form an acyclic graph and may not self-reference; exception tuples use canonical order.
normal_result_contract_label is exactly a result-contract RL or NO_NORMAL_RETURN; an outcome with neither normal return nor exception fails.
Guard kind, operands, operation and expected boolean define one fixed evaluator predicate without candidate dispatch.
Payload branch is selected exactly by SemanticNormalTransfer.kind and expected outcomes never appear as transfer input.
Exception payload derives class, MRO, constructor arguments, cause and context before comparison with expected outcome.
Model kind, exact implementation identity/digest, inputs, effects and transfer graph jointly bind one implementation.
Effect kind fixes the trusted operation and exact input/output/provider model references.
Dependencies and normal/exception transfers form the closed state-operation relation.
